video_title: "The ball got moving pretty good" | Will Hardy speaks to the media following preseason win

quotes.speaker: Will Hardy
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Hardy reflects on team performance in preseason opener
quotes.excerpt: It was a good first effort for our group, plenty of stuff to build on.
quotes.quote: It was a good first effort for our group, plenty of stuff to build on. I thought there were a lot of things that we did pretty well in the game. Obviously, there is tons to clean up, which is to be expected at this point in camp, but I think it is a good one for the group to build on. I thought the ball move was great, 28 assists. The part I am happiest about on that end is only 10 turnovers. I thought we did a good job taking care of the ball.
quotes.social_post: Will Hardy was pleased with the Jazz ball movement in their preseason opener noting 28 assists and only 10 turnovers. He said it was a good first effort for the group with plenty of stuff to build on.

quotes.speaker: Will Hardy
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Hardy praises Keyonte George and Isaiah Collier's offensive impact
quotes.excerpt: I thought they both used their burst to get in the paint.
quotes.quote: I thought they both used their burst to get in the paint. They do it differently. Keyonte George in transition, one-on-one, has the ability to put a lot of pressure on the defense. Not that Isaiah Collier doesn't, but Isaiah uses some off-ball action to get some of those back cuts, turned the corner a few times really nicely off handoffs and pick-and-roll. Those guys both know they have a ton of responsibility to create offense for our group. Sometimes that means that they are just the beginning phase of building the advantage.
quotes.social_post: Will Hardy praised the offensive impact of Keyonte George and Isaiah Collier after the preseason win. He noted that both players know they have a ton of responsibility to create offense for the group.

quotes.speaker: Will Hardy
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Hardy evaluates the chemistry between Jaren Jackson Jr. and Lauri Markkanen
quotes.excerpt: They are both picking their spots pretty well.
quotes.quote: They are both picking their spots pretty well. It is only one game, but we have seen it in practice also. They are both recognizing when their opportunities are to attack and when they need to move it. I thought Lauri Markkanen did not play great in the first half and he ends up with 17. I thought he missed a couple bunnies. Jaren Jackson Jr. had some nice moments where he punished the mismatch with his size. I think when those two are on the floor together, they are a little bit of a matchup problem in terms of their ability to play with some physicality.
quotes.social_post: Will Hardy believes the pairing of Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. creates a matchup problem for opponents due to their size and physicality. He noted they are both picking their spots well.

quotes.speaker: Will Hardy
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Hardy discusses his approach to providing feedback to rookies
quotes.excerpt: My job is to give Darren a lot of feedback.
quotes.quote: My job is to give Darren a lot of feedback. I need to pick the moments appropriately and I need to prioritize what he needs to hear now versus what he may need to hear later. I have preached to our young players for years now that there is a difference between playing poorly and shooting poorly. I thought that Darren a couple of times made really good choices and just missed. If those shots go in, maybe he feels differently. Darren has been a great learner and he is willing to receive feedback. My responsibility, not just with him but with our whole team, is prioritizing what is important for them to hear tomorrow versus what can wait.
quotes.social_post: Will Hardy on coaching rookies like Darren. He emphasizes that there is a difference between playing poorly and shooting poorly and says his job is to prioritize what feedback the players need to hear now.

quotes.speaker: Will Hardy
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Hardy on Darren's growth and poise as a rookie
quotes.excerpt: Darren has been really humble from the moment that he got to us.
quotes.quote: Darren has been really humble from the moment that he got to us in terms of willingness to try to understand better what is happening around him. He asks a lot of questions and it is going to give him the opportunity to be a pretty good player because I think sensitivity to feedback is something you have to get rid of if you really want to become the best version of yourself. We are all trying to help him, just like we are trying to help all the guys on our team. To date, I think he is processing it pretty well. I understand that there is a lot happening for a rookie and you would have to ask him in terms of how it feels, but from my standpoint, I think he has played with a lot of poise.
quotes.social_post: Will Hardy says rookie Darren has played with a lot of poise and is very receptive to feedback. He noted that sensitivity to feedback is something you have to get rid of if you want to become the best version of yourself.
